Bettany. ffe, Cape de Verde Islands, St. Paul's Rocks, Bahia, Rio de Janeiro (April); excursions into interior and amusing adventures; his experiences and horror of slavery; at Monte Video, July; Maldonado, Rio Negro; visit to Tierra del Fuego, Dec. 1833; _rencontre_ with General Rosas; many extinct animals discovered; Buenos Ayres, Sept. 1833; excursion to Santa Fé; Port Desire, Dec.

73801-my-pets.title: Real Happenings in My Aviary
73801-my-pets.creator: Marshall Saunders
73801-my-pets.description: A book by Marshall Saunders. The year was 1899, and I was studying boy life in the charming Belmont School, twenty-five miles from San Francisco. The grounds of the school lie on the lower slope of hills that enclose an open valley fronting the bay of San Francisco. A walk of twelve miles took us to the shores of the Pacific. Close to the school were beautiful cañons that the boys and older persons were never tired of exploring.

arxiv-2101-05327.title: Positron Effects on Polarized Images and Spectra from Jet and Accretion Flow Models of M87* and Sgr A* Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2101-05327.creator: Razieh Emami, Richard Anantua, Andrew A. Chael, Abraham Loeb
arxiv-2101-05327.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Razieh Emami, Richard Anantua, Andrew A. Chael, Abraham Loeb. We study the effects of including a nonzero positron-to-electron fraction in emitting plasma on the polarized SEDs and sub-millimeter images of jet and accretion flow models for near-horizon emission from M87* and Sgr A*. For M87*, we consider a semi-analytic fit to the force-free plasma regions of a general relativistic magnetohydrodynamic jet simulation which we populate with power-law leptons with a constant electron-to-magnetic pressure ratio.

arxiv-2107-00205.title: Ergodic average of typical orbits and typical functions
arxiv-2107-00205.creator: Xiaobo Hou, Wanshan Lin and Xueting Tian
arxiv-2107-00205.description: Abstract . In this article we mainly aim to know what kind of asymptotic behavior of typical orbits can display. For example, we show in any transitive system, the emprical measures of a typical orbit can cover all emprical measures of dense orbits and can intersect some physical-like measures.

arxiv-2203-13831.title: Bioclimatic change as a function of global warming from CMIP6 climate projections
arxiv-2203-13831.description: Abstract Climate change is predicted to lead to major changes in terrestrial ecosystems ( Pörtner et al. 2022 ) . However, significant differences in climate model projections for given scenarios of greenhouse gas emissions ( Masson-Delmotte et al. 2021 ) , continue to hinder detailed assessment.

arxiv-2210-08570.title: Performance of neutron-irradiated 4H-Silicon Carbide diodes subjected to Alpha radiation
arxiv-2210-08570.creator: T. Bergauer
arxiv-2210-08570.description: Abstract The unique electrical and material properties of 4H-silicon-carbide (4H-SiC) make it a promising candidate material for high rate particle detectors. In contrast to the ubiquitously used silicon (Si), 4H-SiC offers a higher carrier saturation velocity and larger breakdown voltage, enabling a high intrinsic time resolution and mitigating pile-up effects.

arxiv-2310-19407.title: Resource Constrained Semantic Segmentation for Waste Sorting
arxiv-2310-19407.creator: Cascina Elisa, Pellegrino Andrea, Tozzi Lorenzo
arxiv-2310-19407.description: Abstract This work addresses the need for efficient waste sorting strategies in Materials Recovery Facilities to minimize the environmental impact of rising waste. We propose resource-constrained semantic segmentation models for segmenting recyclable waste in industrial settings. Our goal is to develop models that fit within a 10MB memory constraint, suitable for edge applications with limited processing capacity.

arxiv-2402-06728.title: Simba-EoR : Early galaxy formation in the Simba simulation including a new sub-grid interstellar medium model 2024 Simba-EoR : Early galaxy formation in the Simba simulation including a new sub-grid interstellar medium model – B
arxiv-2402-06728.creator: E. Jones, B. Smith, R. Davé, D. Narayanan & Q. Li
arxiv-2402-06728.description: Abstract We update the dust model present within the Simba galaxy simulations with a self-consistent framework for the co-evolution of dust and molecular hydrogen populations in the interstellar medium, and use this to explore z ≥ 6 z\geq 6 galaxy evolution.

arxiv-2403-18968.title: Oscillating dark energy in light of the latest observations and it’s impact on the Hubble tension
arxiv-2403-18968.creator: Mehdi Rezaei
arxiv-2403-18968.description: Abstract In this paper we have performed a comparative study of different types of oscillating dark energy models using the Metropolis algorithm of MCMC. Eight different oscillating parameterizations being examined herein which have demonstrated considerable ability to fit the overall cosmological observations including Pantheon sample of SnIa, Baryon Acoustic Oscillations, Cosmic Chronometer Hubble data and distance priors of Planck CMB.

arxiv-2405-19143.title: DeepOKAN: Deep Operator Network Based on Kolmogorov Arnold Networks for Mechanics Problems
arxiv-2405-19143.creator: Diab W. Abueidda, Panos Pantidis, Mostafa E. Mobasher
arxiv-2405-19143.description: Abstract The modern digital engineering design often requires costly repeated simulations for different scenarios. The prediction capability of neural networks (NNs) makes them suitable surrogates for providing design insights. However, only a few NNs can efficiently handle complex engineering scenario predictions.

arxiv-2408-10761.title: On the Power of Graphical Reconfigurable Circuits
arxiv-2408-10761.creator: Yuval Emek, Yuval Gil, Noga Harlev
arxiv-2408-10761.description: Abstract We introduce the graphical reconfigurable circuits (GRC) model as an abstraction for distributed graph algorithms whose communication scheme is based on local mechanisms that collectively construct long-range reconfigurable channels (this is an extension to general graphs of a distributed computational model recently introduced by Feldmann et al. (JCB 2022) for hexagonal grids).

arxiv-2503-03338.title: Navigating Intelligence: A Survey of Google OR-Tools and Machine Learning for Global Path Planning in Autonomous Vehicles
arxiv-2503-03338.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . This study offers an in-depth examination of Global Path Planning (GPP) for unmanned ground vehicles (UGV), focusing on an autonomous mining sampling robot named ROMIE, which plays a crucial role in geochemical mining sampling. GPP is essential for ROMIE’s optimal performance, as it involves solving the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP), a complex graph theory challenge that is crucial for determining the most effective route to cover all sampling locations in a mining field.

arxiv-2507-20830.title: Probing the axion-electron coupling at cavity experiments Preprint: PNUTP-25/A02 Preprint: CTPU-PTC-25-28
arxiv-2507-20830.creator: Deog Ki Hong, Sang Hui Im, Jinsu Kim, TaeHun Kim, SungWoo Youn
arxiv-2507-20830.description: Abstract Axion dark matter induces electromagnetic radiation in conductors through nearly perpetual oscillations of electrons, driven by axion-electron interactions through the so-called chiral magnetic effect. It therefore provides a complementary probe of the axion-electron coupling g a ​ e g_{ae} beyond the conventional axion-photon coupling g a ​ γ g_{a\gamma} in cavities.

arxiv-2509-06014.title: All-order perfect spin hydrodynamics
arxiv-2509-06014.creator: Zbigniew Drogosz
arxiv-2509-06014.description: Abstract We compare two recently developed frameworks of perfect spin hydrodynamics for spin- 1 / 2 1/2 particles, based respectively on classical kinetic theory and the Wigner function. We show that the conserved currents in both approaches have the same form at each order of the expansion in the components of the spin polarization tensor ω \omega .

arxiv-2509-09028.title: Cosmic Ray Spatial Distribution and the Galactic/Extragalactic Transition
arxiv-2509-09028.creator: Paolo Lipari, Silvia Vernetto
arxiv-2509-09028.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Paolo Lipari, Silvia Vernetto. Determining the spatial distribution of Galactic cosmic rays (CRs) is fundamental to understand how these particles propagate in interstellar space and to infer their source spectra. The most sensitive method of studying this problem is observing the gamma–ray and neutrino diffuse fluxes produced in the inelastic interactions of CR protons and nuclei with interstellar gas that encode the energy and spatial distributions of the interacting particles.

arxiv-2510-13267.title: DIGITWISE: Digital Twin-based Modeling of Adaptive Video Streaming Engagement Conference: ACM Multimedia Systems Conference 2024; April 15–18, 2024; Bari, Italy ACM Multimedia Systems Conference 2024 (MMSys ’24), April 15–18, 2024, Bari, Italy DOI: 10.1145/3625468.3647613 ISBN: 979-8-4007-0412-3/24/
arxiv-2510-13267.creator: Emanuele Artioli, Farzad Tashtarian, Christian Timmerer
arxiv-2510-13267.description: Abstract . As the popularity of video streaming entertainment continues to grow, understanding how users engage with the content and react to its changes becomes a critical success factor for every stakeholder. User engagement, i.e., the percentage of video the user watches before quitting, is central to customer loyalty, content personalization, ad relevance, and A/B testing.

arxiv-2511-18047.title: Fidelity-Aware Recommendation Explanations via Stochastic Path Integration
arxiv-2511-18047.creator: Oren Barkan, Yahlly Schein, Yehonatan Elisha, Veronika Bogina, Mikhail Baklanov, Noam Koenigstein
arxiv-2511-18047.description: Abstract Explanation fidelity, which measures how accurately an explanation reflects a model’s true reasoning, remains critically underexplored in recommender systems. We introduce SPINRec (Stochastic Path Integration for Neural Recommender Explanations), a model-agnostic approach that adapts path-integration techniques to the sparse and implicit nature of recommendation data.

arxiv-2601-17514.title: Are Quantum Voting Protocols Practical? DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06
arxiv-2601-17514.creator: Nitin Jha, Abhishek Parakh
arxiv-2601-17514.description: Abstract . Quantum voting protocols aim to offer ballot secrecy and publicly verifiable tallies using physical guarantees from quantum mechanics, rather than relying solely on computational hardness. This article surveys whether such quantum voting protocols are practical. We begin by outlining core mathematical ideas such as the superposition principle, the no-cloning theorem, and quantum entanglement.

pmc-12582190.title: First-Line [177Lu]Lu-PSMA-617 Therapy Without ADT, Chemotherapy, or Local Therapy for Metastatic Hormone-Sensitive Prostate Cancer
pmc-12582190.creator: Vinay K. Giri, Gerald M. Kolodny, Marc B. Garnick
pmc-12582190.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Visual Abstract

The up-front treatment of metastatic prostate adenocarcinoma primarily consists of androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) in combination with androgen receptor pathway inhibitors (ARPIs) with or without taxane-based chemotherapy. 177Lu-vipivotide tetraxetan ([177Lu]Lu-PSMA-617) is indicated for prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)–expressing metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) after progression on ADT and ARPIs and can be administered before chemotherapy in patients for whom deferral of taxane-based therapy is appropriate (1). [177Lu]Lu-PSMA-617 is a radiopharmaceutical β-emitter that targets the transmembrane glycoprotein PSMA.
